hook.title: THE TETON DAM FAILURE
lines: June 5, 1976. Idaho. Teton Dam, 305 feet high, is filling for the first time.
Just before noon, the dam gives way and its reservoir pours through the gap.
Water had found open joints in the rock and was washing out the soil of its core.
The design counted on stopping the water. It had no way to make the leaks harmless.
